title: Neuroscience Sales Specialist - Evansville, IN
description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

Acadia is advancing breakthroughs in neuroscience to elevate life. Since our founding, we have been working at the forefront of healthcare to bring vital solutions to people who need them most. We developed and commercialized the first and only FDA-approved drug to treat hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease psychosis, and the first and only approved drug in the United States and Canada for the treatment of Rett syndrome. Our clinical-stage development efforts are focused on Prader-Willi syndrome, Alzheimer's disease psychosis, and multiple other programs targeting neuro-psychiatric and neuro-rare diseases. For more information, visit Acadia.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Seeking talent near: Evansville, IN; Owensboro, IN

Position Summary

The Neuroscience Sales Specialist is responsible for achieving sales goals within the assigned territory by building strong customer relationships, delivering compliant and compelling product education, and driving appropriate patient access. This role requires expertise in neuroscience, deep knowledge of the local healthcare landscape, and the ability to partner effectively with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and key stakeholders to deliver meaningful value and service.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Promote Acadia products to HCPs in person and virtually, providing clinical, disease state, and reimbursement information in a compliant and customer-focused manner.
  • Develop and execute a territory business plan to meet or exceed sales objectives, leveraging market data, customer insights, and quarterly action plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with HCPs, including key opinion leaders, advocacy organizations, and other healthcare stakeholders.
  • Address customer questions, concerns, and objections using advanced dialogue and selling skills.
  • Tailor approved sales aids, clinical reprints, and brand resources to meet specific customer needs.
  • Partner with internal colleagues (e.g., managed markets, operations, sales training, marketing) to deliver coordinated solutions.
  • Provide guidance on product pricing, reimbursement, and specialty distribution channels, acting as a liaison between customers and the Company for access-related issues.
  • Accurately track and report sales activities, business expenses, and customer interactions in a timely manner.
  • Represent Acadia at conferences, exhibits, and trainings; participate in national, regional, and local meetings as required.
  • Mentor and train new sales specialists as needed, and contribute to cross-functional projects and field strategic insights.

Knowledge & Expertise

  • Deep understanding of neuroscience disease states, Acadia products, and local/regional market dynamics.
  • Ability to serve as a trusted resource in the medical community.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and virtual engagement platforms (e.g., Zoom, WebEx).
  • Strong grasp of payer dynamics, including Part D and specialty pharmacy/hub distribution.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor1s degree required; life sciences preferred.
  • Experience:
    • Sales Specialist : Minimum 1+ years of sales experience in pharmaceutical/healthcare; neuroscience preferred.
    • Senior Specialist : Minimum 5+ years of healthcare sales (2+ in complex/account-based selling).
  • Demonstrated advanced selling skills, leadership abilities, and business acumen.
  • Proven success in influencing diverse HCP audiences across multiple care settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, adapt to change, and deliver consistently high results.
  • Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and possess a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to meet travel requirements, including significant driving and overnight stays; air travel as needed.
  • Must comply with vaccination requirements for HCP office access, long-term care facilities, and medical conferences.

Scope

Applies broad experience and professional judgment to address complex business challenges, using creativity and data-driven decision-making to achieve results in a highly regulated environment.

Physical Requirements

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and the use of hands for handling or operating equipment. The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication both in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. This position requires the ability to travel independently overnight and/or work after hours as required by travel schedule or business needs.

Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and, depending on territory needs, within reasonable proximity to a major airport. Requires eligibility to drive a company vehicle and ability to travel independently by air. Travel may be up to 80% of the time, including occasional after-hours work based on business needs.

Position levels

  • Sales Specialist : 115,000 USD; requires 1+ years of sales experience with at least 1 year in pharmaceutical, and/or other related healthcare sales, with an emphasis on neuroscience preferred.
  • Sales Specialist : 135,000 USD; requires a minimum of 5+ years of healthcare sales with at least 2 years of experience in complex or account-based selling environments is required.

#LI-REMOTE #elev8

In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for discretionary bonus and equity awards based on factors such as individual and organizational performance. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location.

Salary Range

$115,000-$135,000 USD

What we offer US-based Employees

  • Competitive base, bonus, new hire and ongoing equity packages
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Employer-paid life, disability, business travel and EAP coverage
  • 401(k) Plan with a fully vested company match 1:1 up to 5%
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan with a 2-year purchase price lock-in
  • 15+ vacation days
  • 13 -15 paid holidays, including office closure between December 24th and January 1st
  • 10 days of paid sick time
  • Paid parental leave benefit
  • Tuition assistance

EEO Statement (US-based Employees)

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they meet every one of the qualifications in the exact way they are described in job postings. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and innovative company, and we are looking for the BEST candidate for the job. That candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background or may meet the qualifications in a different way. We strongly encourage you to apply, especially if the reason you are the best candidate isn't exactly what we describe here.

As an equal opportunity employer, Acadia is committed to a diverse workforce. Furthermore, you may request additional support if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access Acadia's career website due to your disability, along with any accommodations throughout the interview process. To request or inquire about your reasonable accommodation, please complete our Reasonable Accommodation Request Form or contact us at or .

title: Especialista em Implementação e Suporte de ON!Track
description:
O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com perfil comercial, excelente capacidade de comunicação e apresentação, que tenha facilidade para redesenhar processos operacionais dos clientes, identificar gaps e implementar melhorias usando as soluções digitais da Hilti, especialmente o ON!Track (solução digital que ajuda empresas a gerenciar ferramentas, equipamentos e ativos em tempo real). Este papel é essencial para garantir uma experiência de cliente excepcional e sustentável, atuando em parceria com os times de vendas e marketing locais e regionais.

Em que se consiste o trabalho?

Você será responsável por liderar a implementação dos nossos serviços digitais, com foco em:
  • Treinamento de clientes e melhoria de processos operacionais.
  • Compreensão profunda dos fluxos de trabalho dos clientes para aumentar a produtividade com as soluções Hilti.
  • Coordenação com os times de vendas e marketing locais e regionais para garantir colaboração e inovação.
  • Apoio ao lançamento e adoção de novas funcionalidades dos serviços.
  • Atuação prática e estratégica junto aos clientes, com visitas frequentes e engajamento direto.
  • Este papel exige mobilidade frequente em todo o Brasil,de 2 a 3 semanas por mês (de segunda a sexta-feira).

Isto é o que você precisará:

  • Formação superior completa (não é necessário curso específico).
  • Experiência comercial com foco em relacionamento com clientes.
  • Habilidades de comunicação, apresentação e engajamento.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e pensar de forma operacional.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.
  • Inglês intermediário (desejável).

Por que vale a pena enviar sua candidatura?

Nossos funcionários compartilham um estilo muito próprio de ser. São determinados e dedicados, dando sempre o melhor si para exceder as expectativas dos nossos clientes. Em contrapartida, usufruem de carreiras incrivelmente dinâmicas e diversificadas. 93% dos nossos colaboradores dizem estar orgulhosos em trabalhar para a Hilti, graças à qualidade dos nossos produtos e a forma como cuidamos dos nossos colaboradores.

O que oferecemos?

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Vale alimentação/refeição
  • PPR – Plano de Participação nos Resultados
  • Totalpass (convênio com academias)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • EAP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal (Psicológica, Jurídica, Financeira e Social)
  • Niverday – 1 dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário
  • Auxílio Educacional
  • Premiação por tempo de serviço
  • Cultura de cuidado: gifts em datas especiais
  • Convênio com SESC/SENAC
  • Modelo de trabalho flexível
  • Descontos em produtos

About Us
We are a growing company specializing in luxury short-term rentals and vacation homes. Our portfolio of properties offers unique experiences to travelers worldwide, and we're looking for a skilled professional to join our team.
The Opportunity
We're seeking an experienced and motivated Remote Property Manager to oversee our portfolio of short-term vacation rentals. This role is perfect for a detail-oriented individual who excels in hospitality and property management.
Key Responsibilities
Guest Experience Management

  • Handle guest inquiries and resolve complaints promptly
  • Collaborate with our concierge team to enhance guest satisfaction
  • Ensure top-notch hospitality standards across all properties
Property Operations and Maintenance
  • Coordinate property maintenance, repairs, and upgrades
  • Implement preventative maintenance schedules
  • Conduct routine property inspections
  • Manage relationships with contractors and service providers
Financial Oversight
  • Develop and manage property budgets
  • Prepare financial reports and maintain accurate records
  • Optimize property performance and revenue
Compliance and Risk Management
  • Ensure properties comply with local regulations and safety standards
  • Implement and maintain risk management strategies
  • Stay updated on industry trends and legal requirements
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in property management, or vendor management, preferably in vacation rentals or hospitality
  • Proven track record in guest relations and property operations
  • Strong financial acumen and budget management skills
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities
  • Proficiency in property management software
  • Certifications such as Certified Property Manager (CPM) or Real Property Administrator (RPA) (bonus)
  • Experience with Airbnb, VRBO, or similar platforms is highly desirable
The Ideal Candidate
  • Is a self-starter with excellent time management skills
  • Thrives in a remote work environment
  • Has experience managing properties in the United States (bonus)
  • Has prior experience working remotely in similar property management or hospitality roles
Work Environment
  • Full-time remote position
  • Schedule: Weekend shift, 5 days a week, daytime schedule
  • Must reside in a country with a timezone compatible with US business hours (we do not offer graveyard shift)
Compensation
  • $20,000 annually (contractor position)
  • Opportunity for growth in a dynamic, expanding industry

title: Implementation Analyst – Campinas
description:
With 25 years in the market, Maxtrack is a leader in fleet management, logistics efficiency and high-performance vehicle tracking technology. We have kept our innovative DNA alive since our creation in 1999, with the daily challenge of redefining our own limits, offering the market an increasingly complete, fast and accurate solution. We are not afraid to try: we know that, in an innovative company, mistakes are part of the creation of new processes, products and trends.

About the opportunity

We have a vacancy for Implementation Analyst to join our teams! Have you ever thought about working on the most complete and innovative end-to-end Internet of Things (IoT) platform in Latin America?

Open Hours: 08h daily – Monday to Friday.

Job responsibilities

  • Monitor the operation of products installed at customers' locations and configure equipment and systems according to customer operations (telemetry, SSMA, etc.).
  • Analyze the health of the customer fleet, identifying necessary actions and communicating new business opportunities to the sales team.
  • Assist the sales team with gathering information for presentations and other needs.
  • Implement and monitor the PDCA cycle with clients, generating presentations and follow-up meetings.
  • Monitor the development of new features and provide feedback.
  • Assist customers in emergency situations with claims.
  • Carry out data collection and analysis to verify behavior and make decisions.

Requirements

  • Higher education in progress or completed.
  • Office package and systems skills;
  • Technical Knowledge in Vehicle Telemetry, Risk Management (Cargo Theft), Fuel Consumption and Fleet Analysis;

You stand out if

  • Analytical thinking and proactive problem solving;
  • Communication and interpersonal relationship skills;
  • Proactivity and ability to work independently;
  • Flexibility for travel and remote work.

Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade para entrar no mercado de trabalho, essa pode ser a chance ideal. A Associação Junior Achievement do Brasil está oferecendo 300 vagas para Operador de Telemarketing , com a grande vantagem de não exigir experiência anterior . A modalidade é home office , o que permite mais comodidade e flexibilidade no dia a dia.

A Associação Junior Achievement do Brasil é uma das principais instituições sem fins lucrativos voltadas à formação de jovens para o mercado de trabalho, empreendedorismo e educação financeira. O que faz um Operador de Telemarketing?

O Operador de Telemarketing tem como principal função realizar atendimentos ativos e receptivos. Isso significa que o profissional pode tanto entrar em contato com clientes quanto receber ligações. As tarefas incluem fornecer informações, sanar dúvidas, registrar solicitações e, em alguns casos, oferecer produtos e serviços.

Requisitos para a vaga

Para concorrer a uma das vagas, é necessário:

Ensino médio completo

Ser maior de 18 anos

Possuir computador com acesso à internet

Residir em Nossa Senhora do Socorro , Barra dos Coqueiros , Aracaju ou São Cristóvão

O processo de seleção será feito de forma remota. A empresa avaliará os candidatos com base nos requisitos informados, e o contato será realizado por telefone ou e-mail. Não é exigida experiência anterior, o que torna a vaga uma excelente porta de entrada para o mercado de trabalho.

Mesmo sem experiência, você pode aumentar suas chances se:

Demonstrar boa comunicação verbal

Ter disciplina e organização para trabalhar em casa

Mostrar disposição para aprender e crescer dentro da empresa

Conclusão

Essa é uma ótima oportunidade para quem deseja iniciar uma carreira, principalmente com a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto . A Junior Achievement está abrindo portas para centenas de pessoas que procuram uma chance de mostrar seu potencial. Não perca tempo e envie seu currículo se você se encaixa no perfil!

title: Gestão De Projetos, Marketing E Operações
description:
Overview

Estou buscando por um(a) Gestor(a) de Projetos com perfil ágil, organizado e versátil para me apoiar na gestão e operação de três negócios distintos: nas áreas de design, bebidas experimentais e imóveis.

A função envolve atuar no dia a dia desses projetos organizando tarefas, acompanhando entregas, negociando com fornecedores e ajudando a manter tudo em andamento. É essencial ter boa comunicação escrita, inclusive em inglês (leitura e escrita), familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos como Notion ou Clickup, e disposição para lidar com frentes variadas; desde o acompanhamento de entregas de design para clientes internacionais até o suporte para a organização de um projeto de reforma de um imóvel, operação de uma microindústria de bebidas ou manutenção de uma campanha de anúncios.

A função envolverá também atuação direta para garantir que as coisas aconteçam de ponta a ponta: orçar, comprar, agendar, organizar cronogramas, negociar com fornecedores, atualizar planilhas, resolver pendências e destravar o que for preciso.

É fundamental que a pessoa tenha facilidade real para aprender coisas novas e complexas, com raciocínio rápido e capacidade de entender contextos variados com profundidade. Muitos dos projetos envolvem temas técnicos diversos e pouco padronizados, que exigem agilidade para pesquisar, interpretar e aplicar informações com autonomia. Busco alguém com inteligência prática, curiosidade ativa e flexibilidade para navegar entre assuntos distintos, aprendendo rapidamente o uso de ferramentas e processos de acordo com novos desafios.

Design (Bas-Alto)

Estúdio de design com atuação internacional (apenas clientes estrangeiros, em inglês) em projetos de identidade visual, website e product design.

  • Comunicação escrita com clientes e parceiros (em inglês) para acompanhamento de projetos.
  • Delegação, briefing e hand-off de tarefas para o time de designers;
  • Acompanhamento de entregas em projetos simultâneos.

Bebidas (Caém do Brasil)

Microindústria de sidras e bebidas fermentadas com sede em Curitiba.

caembrasil.com.br | instagram.com / caembrasil

  • Gerenciamento de campanhas de marketing, tráfego pago e vendas;
  • Apoio em lançamentos e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Participação em reuniões semanais com a equipe para priorização e delegação de tarefas;
  • Apoio administrativo, financeiro e operacional do negócio.

Negócios Imobiliários

Micro incorporadora focada em house flipping e construção de casas modernistas em Belo Horizonte.

  • Apoio geral na organização e logística de reformas e obras;
  • Acompanhamento dos projetos com as equipes responsáveis;
  • Organização de planilhas e sistemas como Notion e Google Sheets.

Requisitos e perfil profissional

  • Proatividade real e pique de fazer acontecer;
  • Agilidade para mover entre contextos variados e mergulhar em novos desafios;
  • Organização e experiência com gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Facilidade em aprender novas ferramentas ou se aprofundar em tópicos variados;
  • Clareza na escrita e na comunicação;
  • Inglês fluente (leitura e escrita).

Diferenciais

  • Interesse ou experiência no mundo do design, marketing, produtos digitais, arquitetura ou bebidas;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Notion, planilhas e sistemas de produtividade;
  • Entendimento de processos de design e experiência com ferramentas da área, como o Figma.

Formato

  • Carga horária integral, com horários flexíveis;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto, com preferência para quem reside em Curitiba ou Belo Horizonte - mas não necessário;
  • Remuneração: entre R$3.000 a R$5.000+, conforme o nível de senioridade e autonomia prática;

description:
Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal

Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
Our Inbound Sales Representatives connect and engage with prospective clients who originate from inbound leads. They seek new business opportunities by connecting with, and developing relationships with, potential customers and guiding prospective clients throughout the required sales stages. To excel in this position, you need to effectively communicate and collaborate with clients, ensuring they understand the value of our services and how Toptal can support their goals. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and supporting our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will be responsible for executing upon a customer-centric approach across all of your customer interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with our prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role and at Toptal.
In the first week, expect to:
  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training process which conveys our value proposition, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
In the first month, expect to:
  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Be able to accurately articulate Toptal’s value proposition and process.
  • Be able to speak to incoming leads, understand the clients’ needs, overcome any objections, present the value proposition of Toptal, and close leads that are a good fit for Toptal.
  • Work alongside the various business units to ensure your prospects are progressing through the funnel.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
In the first three months, expect to:
  • Be fully ramped up and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Possess a healthy pipeline of prospects that are working through your funnel.
  • Exhibit a successful track record of hitting sales goals.
In the first six months, expect to:
  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals.
  • Identify process improvement areas to help increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.
  • Continue to implement sales best practices for client interactions and follow-up.
In the first year, expect to:
  • Begin to mentor new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Continue to gain and close new business along with managing your funnel to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of B2B sales experience (i.e. Account Executive, Inside Sales, Outside Sales Representative, Account Representative, or related title).
  • Software or tech-related sales experience and education are a plus.
  • Be attentive to client needs. You will be required to be fully available during your working hours to take client calls.
  • You are client-centric. You will be working with prospective clients daily, uncovering and resolving clients’ issues through value-based selling.
  • Have a “will-to-win” attitude. You’re looking to not only meet but exceed your quota and are naturally competitive. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission and want our Client Advisors to make the most out of it!
  • You’re a “learn-it-all.” We are looking for someone who is always looking to grow, strives for improvement, and constantly seeks feedback from peers/ leaders. Even as an individual contributor, you seek to share and gain knowledge from those around you.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with your team members.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. We move quickly, so having exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage a high volume of clients is key to being successful in this role.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Job description

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing; bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn’t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise: 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics: Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience: Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

Location: Remote (Chicago or New York preferred, but flexible for the right candidate). Reports to: Senior Vice President, Strategic Initiatives. About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Director of Pricing & Packaging to lead and evolve the company’s global pricing and packaging strategy. This leadership role is responsible for setting the vision and driving execution for pricing and packaging as a core growth lever, ensuring alignment with AlphaSense’s go-to-market strategy, product roadmap, and financial goals.

You will own pricing strategy end-to-end—from vision through execution—partnering cross-functionally to define frameworks, optimize monetization across product lines, and evolve our pricing model in a rapidly changing market, including the rise of AI-enabled workflows. Your work will directly impact revenue, customer retention, unit economics, and competitive differentiation across all customer segments and geographies.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Global Pricing & Packaging Strategy: Define and execute a long-term pricing strategy that aligns with AlphaSense’s business model, growth goals, and product evolution—including our increasing AI-driven capabilities.
  • Partner for Strategic Impact: Act as the connective tissue across product, finance, marketing, sales, and customer success to ensure pricing and packaging decisions are informed by deep market understanding, operational feasibility, and customer insights.
  • Drive Monetization of Innovation: Develop monetization strategies for new product lines, AI capabilities, usage models, and tiered offerings. Translate technical innovation into commercial value.
  • Design for Customer Behavior: Understand how buying behaviors vary by region, segment, and use case. Tailor pricing models to different markets while ensuring cohesion across the portfolio.
  • Lead with Insight: Build and maintain competitive intelligence on industry pricing trends, packaging innovations, and customer willingness-to-pay. Embed rigorous data analysis and modeling in decision-making.
  • Own Governance & Execution: Establish a scalable pricing governance process, ensuring internal alignment, operational readiness, and change management for any new pricing models or updates.
  • Forecast and Optimize: Partner with finance to model revenue, margin, and retention impacts of pricing scenarios. Track and optimize pricing performance KPIs.
  • Be a Change Leader: Champion pricing and packaging as strategic capabilities across the company. Influence stakeholders at all levels with compelling business cases and storytelling.

Who You Are

  • Proven Pricing Leader: 10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS pricing and packaging, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership or strategic ownership role.
  • Experience with Complex B2B Customers: You understand how financial institutions, corporations, consulting firms, and professional services organizations evaluate and purchase software, and know how to design pricing and packaging that aligns with their high-stakes needs and structured buying processes.
  • AI-Savvy Operator: Familiarity with how GenAI is reshaping product delivery, user workflows, and commercial models and ready to adapt pricing strategy accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestrator: Experienced in partnering with product, marketing, finance, sales, and customer success to drive cross-company alignment and execution.
  • Analytical & Strategic Thinker: Strong modeling skills and comfort with data-driven decision-making, combined with the ability to zoom out to strategic impact.
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Empathy for end-users and buyers. Skilled at interpreting qualitative feedback and usage data into actionable pricing insights.
  • Excellent Communicator: Capable of influencing executive stakeholders and driving decisions without direct authority. Strong executive presence and storytelling ability.
  • Builder at Heart: Thrives in high-growth, fast-paced environments. Comfortable creating structure from ambiguity and scaling systems for the future.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn’t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

title: Senior Partner Operations Analyst
description:
About 1Password

At 1Password, we're building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Extended Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 165,000 businesses and millions of people trust us to provide seamless, secure access to their most critical information.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Partners are central to our future growth. The Global Partner Team empowers them with the tools, programs, and resources they need to succeed and grow with 1Password.

We're looking for a Partner Operations Manager to streamline internal processes, reporting, policies, and communications that support our partner-facing teams. In this role, you'll improve partner tools, enhance workflows, and drive operational efficiency—internally and externally.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate with teams across partnerships, sales, legal, and marketing. Reporting to a Senior Manager in Revenue Operations, you'll help scale our partner program and contribute to 1Password's continued growth.

You'll join 1Password as a key member of the Revenue Operations team, working cross-functionally with partnerships, sales, legal, and marketing to drive operational excellence in our partner program. You'll report to a Senior Manager within Revenue Operations, under the VP of Revenue Operations.

This is a Remote opportunity within Canada and the United States.

What we're looking for

  • Partner Operations/Revenue Operations - You have a minimum of 3 years experience driving success strategies for a growing partner program, partnership management, or relevant experience within Revenue Operations in the technology industry. You have the experience and confidence to identify areas for strategic improvements, advocate for them internally, implement them, and evolve them.
  • Strong Understanding of Salesforce required - You have experience working with Salesforce and have a strong understanding of its core functionalities around data management, reporting, dashboarding and large scale updates. Salesforce administrator certification is an asset.
  • The Ability to Build and Evolve - The Partner Program is primed with huge growth, but there is so much to still figure out to ensure that our partners are armed for success while scaling our business globally. We need a proactive, independent thinker with high energy and positive attitude. You'll bring a flexible and pragmatic mindset, leverage your resources to solve problems with much ambiguity, and adapt to a fast-paced changing environment.
  • Structured and Organized Approach - You're hyper-organized, and can manage multiple projects and deliverables simultaneously. You're able to manage multiple projects at various stages that require cross functional collaboration and alignment.
  • A Good Human Being - You act with integrity, kindness and respect, always. You're confident enough to challenge the norms and suggest meaningful changes, but humble enough to be part of a strong culture and team that embraces diversity and open discussion.

What you can expect

  • Partner Process—Internal & External - Own the partners sales process internally and externally from end to end. This includes ensuring that current processes are optimized and scalable, and proactively building additional functionalities as the business evolves. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders to create workflows, automations and improvements to drive incremental value.
  • Partner Performance Reporting - You will implement the necessary data structure and reporting to support the tracking and measurements of success for partnerships. You will monitor systems and workflows to ensure data integrity in common metrics such as ARR, partner adoption, engagement, marketing activities, and incentive/spiffs are common measurements of success.
  • Global Partner Success and Health - Behind the scenes, you're ensuring that our partner-facing teams have everything they need to be successful, working alongside several internal teams to ensure that we have the right automations and processes in place, tools, documentation, policies, and communications to recruit, engage and motivate our partner community.
  • We believe in the power of remote work, but we also recognize that some in-person connection with team members and customers is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, occasional travel for in-person engagement will be a part of this role. This may include but is not limited to bi-annual department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events will typically be held in varying locations across Canada and the USA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $87,000USD and $117,000USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $87,000 CAD and $117,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You'll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We're looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged at 1Password—it’s an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

Our approach to work

We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
Generous PTO policy
Four company-wide wellness days

Growth and future
Company equity for all full-time employees
Retirement matching program
Free 1Password account

Community
Paid volunteer days
Employee-led inclusion and belonging programs and ERGs
Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

You belong here.

We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at and we'll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

  • Portfolio showcasing integrated marketing campaigns, presentation materials (PowerPoint and/or Google Slides), and consistent brand execution across channels.
  • Familiarity with global and multi-audience brand challenges.

Values:

  • We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of AI and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

title: Outsource Producer
description:
Overview

Devoted Studios is a US-based game development company specializing in Co-development, Porting, and End-to-End Art Production for the global gaming industry. With a distributed team of over 1,900+ skilled professionals , we collaborate across time zones to support projects on all major platforms, engines and styles —from AAA titles to emerging technologies.   • 2K
  • Xbox
  • Meta
  • Obsidian Entertainment
  • Turtle Rock Studios
  • Gearbox Software

Devoted Studios is seeking a proactive and experienced Outsource Art Director to join our external game development team. In this dynamic, fast-paced role, your creative vision, technical expertise, and leadership will directly influence the quality and success of our projects and partnerships. You\'ll collaborate with world-class gaming clients and internal teams to drive artistic direction, uphold visual standards, and deliver high-quality assets across a wide range of styles and genres. If you\'re passionate about leading remote art teams, shaping creative solutions, and ensuring flawless execution in external development, we\'d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Develop Comprehensive Proposals: Align client expectations with Devoted\'s expertise — creating structured bids, defining quality targets, and outlining a step-by-step approach to executing on client requirements
  • Client Communication & Clarification: Serve as the main point of contact for clients, clarifying their needs and providing creative, expert recommendations with urgency to quickly close bids
  • Client Calls & Technical Notes: Attend client calls to gather information on scope extensions or potential new projects. Provide clear technical notes to the internal team via JIRA to ensure smooth project execution
  • Bid Collaboration: Work with Business Development and the CEO to finalize bids, ensuring all details are addressed. Create detailed RFPs for the team and manage their progression to maintain momentum
  • Project Transition: Own the transition from pre-production to production, ensuring a seamless handoff of all relevant information including project details, timelines, and rates
  • Pipeline Management: Maintain a steady pipeline of projects, ensuring ongoing visibility into the status and progress of client initiatives
  • Enhance Service Sales: Collaborate with production and leads to improve the sale of tailored services, such as offering small test deliverables, refining how specific services are pitched, updating portfolios and mini-decks, and preparing templated proposals to support sales efforts

Requirements

  • 3-5 years in a similar Art Director, Lead Artist, or External Development role within the video game industry
  • Demonstrated experience directing and delivering outsourced art across various styles and platforms, including detailed feedback and quality control
  • Strong understanding of game art pipelines (2D, 3D, UI/UX, animation, etc.) and the ability to communicate visual requirements and expectations clearly
  • Comfortable working with project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) and asset management platforms to coordinate deliveries, milestones, and feedback loops
  • High level of responsiveness and ownership, with the ability to maintain strong client relationships and uphold Devoted\'s reputation for quality and professionalism
  • Creative problem-solver with a collaborative mindset—able to align artistic vision with client goals and propose innovative solutions under tight timelines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Willingness to work partially within PST-EST time zones to ensure alignment with clients and internal teams

Benefits

  • Strong and enthusiastic team - opportunity for knowledge sharing, learning, and professional self-development
  • Interesting and challenging tasks - solve diverse and challenging issues, communicate with people within the company as well as with our partners
  • Convenient working conditions - remote work, flexible working hours
  • A chance to work in a highly professional and dynamic team with international game production projects, attractive remuneration package, and opportunities to develop professionally

This is a remote, full-time contracted position.

We are an equal opportunity company and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contract without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:
Overview

We’re looking for a Web Analytics & Attribution Specialist to help us deliver clean, reliable tracking and actionable insights for our clients. title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : \"work smart\", \"overdeliver\", \"speed is king\" and \"better everyday\". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn\'t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

Senior Software Engineer | Data Platform Team

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company. We are rebranding as Wellhub from Gympass, marking a milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to our Data Platform team in Brazil (Remote) !

The Data Platform Team is responsible for building and maintaining system components that pave the way for data engineers and analysts to deliver their business objectives. This team leverages open-source software, uses cloud infrastructure and services, and builds software to accomplish its mission.

People on this team have different technical backgrounds, such as software engineering, systems administration (Kubernetes), cloud infrastructure and services, data analysis, and data governance.

This is an established team with a strong culture that expects collaboration, humbleness, accountability, empathy, and a sense of humor.

Some ongoing and future projects

  • Migrate existing data lake tables to Apache Iceberg
  • Autoscale Trino for data transformation pipelines
  • Creating a GitHub App to manage table schemas with data contracts (GitOps + DataOps)
  • Optimize data lake tables for existing queries with statistics collection and file rewrites

YOUR IMPACT

  • Advocate for improvements in software quality, security, and performance
  • Embrace the DataOps mindset to streamline and optimize repetitive tasks
  • Collaborate with Analytics Engineers and Data Analysts to drive efficiencies for their work
  • Provide tooling that improves the product development process and prevents failures
  • Ensure that knowledge is shared effectively with internal documentation and personal interaction
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • BS degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience
  • Solid experience with Python, Java, or similar
  • Solid understanding of relational databases fundamentals and solid SQL skills (PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Familiarity with Kafka, Pulsar, or RabbitMQ (Kafka preferred)
  • Proficiency with Terraform, Pulumi, or Crossplane (Kubernetes experience desired)
  • Experience with distributed systems and data-intensive applications
  • Knowledge of analytical data warehouses
  • Genuine interest in big data applications and their technology trends

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !
